I have had ball of foot and heel issues in the past so one of the best features with these boots (that is not noted in the product description or other reviews) is the comfortable padded memory foam insole that adds support and comfort to the ball of your foot, the arch, and the heel.  These are a high quality, well-crafted pair of boots that will complement daily casual wear and will convert any outfit to a more sophisticated evening look.  I'm extremely impressed with the overall design and attention to detail given, and highly recommend these!  These will be your go to pair that will transition you from fall into winter and spring for years to come.
